content.text:
Created animated SVG at **`anteater.svg`** (800×600):

- **Anteater:** Long tubular snout with flicking tongue, bushy swaying tail, black-and-white body band, red scarf, and cap — bobbing as it rides.
- **Unicycle:** Rotating spoked wheel with red rim, rotating crank/pedals, and legs pedaling in sync.
- **Juggling 3 bottles:** Green, orange, and purple bottles follow a looping juggling path via `animateMotion` (staggered 1.8s cycles with auto-rotation), above animated juggling arms.
- **Scene & motion:** Sunny sky/sun, drifting clouds, scrolling ground/flowers to simulate forward movement, shadow squash, sparkles, and speed lines — all with CSS/SMIL animations, no external assets.

Open `anteater.svg` in any browser to view the animation.
